test_title: PYST 7: SSC MTS 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: P sells a toy to Q at a profit of 40 percent and Q sells it to R at a profit of 10 percent. If R pays Rs. 539 for the toy, then what was the cost price of toy for P?
solution:
**Given**

P sold the toy to Q at 40% profit

Q sold it to R at 10% profit

R paid Rs. 539 for the toy

**Formula used:**

Profit percent = [(Selling Price - Cost Price)/Cost Price] × 100

**Solution:**

⇒ Selling Price of Q to R = Rs. 539

⇒ Cost Price for Q = Selling Price of Q to R / (1 + profit% of Q) = 539/1.1

⇒ Cost Price for P = Cost Price for Q/(1 + profit% of P)

**Therefore, the cost price of the toy for P is Rs. 350 **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** 539 = CP of P × 140/100 × 110/100

⇒ CP of P = (539 × 100)/(14 × 11) = Rs. 350

∴ The cost price of the toy for P is Rs. 350.
